races.paceDynamic: Atlantic City is the only confirmed front runner in a small field of eight, meaning she can dictate terms without pressure through the early stages. With six hold-up horses and one prominent runner, the pace is likely to be steady rather than fierce, allowing Atlantic City to control the tempo. The majority of the field will be held up off what could be a modest gallop, potentially creating a sprint finish where tactical positioning becomes crucial. This setup moderately favours prominent/early position horses who can track the pace and kick when it matters, as hold-up horses may find themselves with too much to do if the tempo is sedate.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Leader
scenarios.trigger: If Atlantic City gets an easy lead and dictates a steady tempo
scenarios.body: She can control the race from the front without pressure, then have enough left to resist the late challengers. The hold-up horses will have ground to make up in the straight against a horse who has conserved energy.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Finish Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly testing in the final three furlongs after a steady start
scenarios.body: The class horses with hold-up styles can unleash their finishing kicks to overhaul the leaders. First Candidate and Diamond Grace have the ratings and tactical speed to mount telling late challenges.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses try to challenge Atlantic City for the early lead or press the pace
scenarios.body: This creates a faster tempo that will set up the race for the hold-up horses perfectly. The pace will collapse in the final furlong, allowing the best finishers to come through.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the unconsidered runners benefits from the race shape and tactical positioning
scenarios.body: A horse like Flash Bardot or Diamond Grace could be produced with a perfectly timed run. The small field and potential lack of pace could see an outsider slip through with ideal positioning.

Diamond Grace's market support - any confidence from the O'Neill team would be significant given their poor recent record
The early pace development - if no one goes with Atlantic City the race could become a tactical crawl
Dolly Drama's position turning in - she needs the race to develop into a sprint to showcase her finishing kick

races.paceDynamic: Bucephalus, We're Red And Blue, and Tashan will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with three confirmed front-runners guaranteeing strong early fractions. Smart Decision, Dance And Glance, Frontier Prince, Marche d'Aligre, and Inedit d'Amour all want prominent positions, creating congestion and traffic problems turning for home. The pace will be searching throughout this 1m7½f trip, stringing out the field and testing stamina reserves. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the genuine pace will expose the prominent pack and allow closers to pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders maintain a strong gallop and the prominent pack gets into trouble
scenarios.body: The searching pace will string out the field and leave the hold-up horses with plenty to aim at in the straight. Traffic problems among the prominent runners will open up gaps for the patient rides.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent position wins
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can secure a clean passage and avoid the traffic
scenarios.body: The winner will need to be handy enough to avoid trouble but have enough left to quicken when it matters. Dance And Glance or Smart Decision could benefit from their recent form edge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runner stays on
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is more modest than expected and one leader conserves energy
scenarios.body: Bucephalus has winning form over this trip recently and could dictate terms if allowed an easier lead than anticipated. His experience at this level gives him an edge over the other pace-setters.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider emerges late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the final half-mile
scenarios.body: A horse that gets completely overlooked in the betting could benefit from a slowly-run race that becomes a sprint finish. The form horses would be vulnerable in this scenario.

races.paceDynamic: Ernest Gray is the sole confirmed front runner in this 9-runner field and should get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable gallop over this staying trip. With Porter In The Park, I Am Max and Jakar Du Moulin likely to track in behind, the pace will be honest but not punishing early. The large contingent of hold-up horses - Super Survivor, Blue Carpet, Heather Honey, Secret Trix and Walden - will be relying on the pace to collapse in the final half-mile. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses - Ernest Gray will have done too much work up front and the closers will have plenty to aim at in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Ernest Gray sets honest fractions but tires from the last hurdle
scenarios.body: The pace will be perfect for the back markers who can unleash late runs up the Haydock straight. Super Survivor and Blue Carpet have the class and tactical speed to capitalise.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too strong with Ernest Gray pressed by the prominent runners
scenarios.body: Ernest Gray will tie up badly and Porter In The Park or I Am Max will inherit but also struggle home. The hold-up brigade sweep past in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Ernest Gray sets modest fractions and the hold-up horses are too far back
scenarios.body: I Am Max or Porter In The Park can slip the field turning for home before the closers can respond. Their superior early positioning proves decisive over this stamina-sapping trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sustained Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Ernest Gray gets very soft fractions and the field comes too late
scenarios.body: The leader kicks clear after the last and holds on as the closers make ground but run out of real estate. His 105-day break could have freshened him up completely.

races.paceDynamic: Minella Drama is the only confirmed front-runner and will face no early pressure, allowing him to dictate a measured tempo through the early stages. However, with 7 runners wanting prominent positions (Numitor, Le Milos, Outlaw Peter, Guard Your Dreams, Neon Moon, The Flier Begley, The Widdow Maker, Whistleinthedark, Filanderer), serious traffic problems will develop from 2-3 furlongs out as they all converge. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Courtland, Triple Trade, Dubai Days, Fugitif, Genois, Lord Baddesley, Dreal Deal) will benefit from the honest gallop and have clear runs late. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — they avoid the mid-race scramble and can pick off tired prominent runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group gets into a prolonged battle from 3 furlongs out while Minella Drama fades.
scenarios.body: The seven hold-up horses get perfect splits through tired legs, with the in-form Triple Trade and class act Courtland having ideal ammunition. Fresh challengers sweep past the early scrimmagers in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Late
scenarios.trigger: If Minella Drama sets too slow a pace and the prominent group fails to organize.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where The Flier Begley's recent wins and Filanderer's consistent form pay dividends in a bunched finish. Late closers get their chance but lack the acceleration needed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front End Holds Firm
scenarios.trigger: If Minella Drama gets an easy lead and one prominent runner (likely Le Milos or Guard Your Dreams) gets first run.
scenarios.body: The Skelton stable's 21% strike-rate pays off with Le Milos, or Guard Your Dreams justifies the headgear change by staying on strongly. The field strings out behind the early pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Battle
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners press Minella Drama early, creating stronger pace than expected.
scenarios.body: The pace becomes genuinely searching, suiting only the proven stayers with tactical speed like Numitor or Whistleinthedark. Most runners struggle to cope with the enhanced gallop over this extended trip.

scenarios.title: Front-runner survives

scenarios.body: Royal Deeside's lower weight or Victoria Milano's stamina allows them to control the tempo and kick clear when the field closes. The pace scenario doesn't materialize as strongly as expected.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Moderate pace surprise
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders are cautious early, creating a more tactical affair than expected

scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and a horse from midfield or worse comes with a sustained run.
scenarios.body: A steadily-run race would suit a horse that has been given too much ground to make up but possesses superior stamina reserves. The field would come back to the closers in the final furlong.

watchPoints.text: Saladins Son could steal a march if the pace is more sedate than expected and he's allowed an easy lead
Watch for Jupiter Des Bordes who could be overpriced given his recent win and the trainer's minimal runner policy
Major Fortune's market moves will be telling given Dan Skelton's excellent 21% strike-rate over the past fortnight
Any late money for Cerendipity with first-time tongue-tie and trainer hitting form recently
Track Solar System's jumping early — if fluent he could be the strongest closer in the field
